The gate's own suggested fix was also self-contradictory, asking to shift the art down to protect both the top text and the bottom detail simultaneously.
open_item_for_chatgpt_creative.recommended: If the trim is judged material, reissue core-026-production-slim-1382x4161 with slightly larger internal top and bottom safe margins. The swap is a single asset replacement on the existing product.
